# `/sod-violation-report` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /sod-violation-report/v1/run

`startSodAllPoliciesForOrgV1` — Runs all policies for org

Runs multi-policy report for the org. If a policy reports more than 5000 violations, the report mentions that the violation limit was exceeded for that policy. If the request is empty, the report runs for all policies. Otherwise, the report runs for only the filtered policy list provided.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage
- Body (application/json): multipolicyrequest
- Returns 200: reportresultreference

### GET /sod-violation-report/v1

`getSodAllReportRunStatusV1` — Get multi-report run task status

This endpoint gets the status for a violation report for all policy run.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- Returns 200: reportresultreference

### GET /sod-violation-report/v1/{reportResultId}/download

`getDefaultViolationReportV1` — Download violation report

This allows to download a violation report for a given report reference.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- Parameters:
  - `reportResultId` (path, required) — The ID of the report reference to download.
- Returns 200: no body

### GET /sod-violation-report/v1/{reportResultId}/download/{fileName}

`getCustomViolationReportV1` — Download custom violation report

This allows to download a specified named violation report for a given report reference.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- Parameters:
  - `reportResultId` (path, required) — The ID of the report reference to download.
  - `fileName` (path, required) — Custom Name for the file.
- Returns 200: no body
